instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Set the global background color strictly to deep black (#050505) and text color to white.
CRITICAL: Add @import statements in your global CSS to load 'Great Vibes' and 'Outfit' Google Fonts.
Typography Usage: Apply 'font-great-vibes' to headings, hero text ('Bienvenue', 'La beauté est notre passion'), and decorative titles. Apply 'font-outfit' to all other components.
Hero Section: On the home page, the main image MUST be perfectly circular (`rounded-full`) and have a prominent pink glow effect (`shadow-[0_0_25px_rgba(255,20,147,0.6)]`).

Bottom Navigation: Implement fixed bottom navigation with 5 distinct states. The ACTIVE tab must pop out of the bar (e.g., `-translate-y-8`), have a solid pink circular background (`#FF1493`), and a pink shadow glow. The INACTIVE tabs stay flat and muted.
UI Radius Strategy: The user specifically wants smooth, rounded edges. Cards should be `rounded-[25px]`, pills and primary buttons should be `rounded-full`.
Neon Glow Effects: Whenever a primary action is active (like the active filter pill or the admin PIN button press), apply the glowing shadow class `shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(255,20,147,0.5)]`.
Admin PIN Screen: The PIN keypad needs to have large round numeric buttons (80x80px). Ensure the active/pressed state of these buttons turns the background neon pink with a pink glow.
Testing: Add explicit `data-testid` attributes to every button, navigation link, filter pill, and input in the app.
